text.content:
Adepts are masters of mind, body, and spirit, using their inner clarity to achieve supernatural feats.

SKILLS

CLARITY · SL max 3

On your turn, you may choose to spend an action and destroy a pair of Motes you possess to gain one of the following cumulative bonuses, at your discretion:

  • immunity to a chosen status effect;
  • your attacks or spells of a chosen damage type ignore Resistances;
  • you gain Resistance to a chosen damage type.

The number of bonuses you can have active at any given moment is equal to (SL). You cannot select the same benefit more than once.

RESERVE · SL max 3

You begin a conflict scene with (SL × 2) Motes, up to your Mote limit.

RESTORATION · SL max 2

Choose up to three creatures. As an action, release your Motes towards them, spending 2 MP per Mote. Each delivered Mote restores (SL × 5) HP or MP, at your discretion. Each Mote released is destroyed.

DISCHARGE · SL max 2

As an action, choose any number of Motes to release in a ranged attack against enemies, spending 2 MP per Mote. Perform a (DEX + WLP) Check. On a hit, each target loses (SL × 4) HP or MP per Mote, based on your choice. This damage ignores Resistances.

Motes targeting HP affect the target's Defense, while those targeting MP affect their Magic Defense. Each Mote is destroyed after release, whether it hits or not.

WARD · SL max 3

As a reaction, release any number of Motes to reduce incoming damage to you or up to three creatures by (SL × 2) per Mote released, before applying any damage Affinities. Each Mote destroyed this way costs 2 MP.
